articles.value: Set the World on Fire With This Neheb, the Eternal Trimmed Deck
articles.excerpt: This week we're trimming all the expensive fat from the mono-red Neheb, the Eternal Commander decks. Is it still good on a budget?

articles.value: Brewing an Ozai, the Phoenix King deck with Universes Beyond Cards
articles.excerpt: If your idea of fun is accumulating mana for one massive, game-ending turn, Ozai is ready to rule over your next Commander pod.
With almost 500 new cards that can be your commander released in 2025, it's easy to overlook some. Bennie's here with some great picks.

articles.value: Incinerating Tyranny With a Fire Lord Zuko Commander Deck
articles.excerpt: As a commander, Fire Lord Zuko is a formidable and fun build-around. This deck tech seeks to utilize all parts of Zuko's abilities.

articles.value: Edge of Eternities - Ragost, Deft Gastronaut Deck Tech
